objective: Determine the tapeout signoff status of six hard macros from the supplied floorplan, static-timing, DRC, and LVS records.

items.rationale: floorplan reported utilization 0.72 from supplied_summary, at or below the 0.80 target. static_timing echoed WNS 0.085 ns with computed=false and no separate source field; drc_check reported 0 violations and lvs_check reported 0 discrepancies, also from supplied summaries. All four checks therefore meet the brief's tapeout_ready criteria, subject to the stated evidence limitations.
evidence: static_timing: wns=0.085 ns; computed=false; no separate source field reported; no refusal reported

items.rationale: floorplan reported utilization 0.80 from supplied_summary, exactly at rather than above the target. static_timing echoed WNS 0.000 ns with computed=false, which the brief defines as closed; DRC and LVS each returned a zero count. All four checks therefore meet the tapeout_ready criteria at the permitted boundaries.
evidence: static_timing: wns=0 ns (input 0.000 ns); computed=false; no separate source field reported; no refusal reported

items.rationale: lvs_check rejected tapeout with the blocking output '2 LVS discrepancies — zero-discrepancy LVS policy requires all discrepancies resolved before tapeout', establishing the LVS failure and supplying the discrepancy count. The other calls reported utilization 0.65, WNS 0.210 ns, and DRC violations 0, but those results cannot override the LVS failure. The output was a substantive policy rejection rather than an inability to assess the supplied LVS record.
evidence: static_timing: wns=0.21 ns (input 0.210 ns); computed=false; no separate source field reported; no refusal reported
lvs_check: error='[SEMICON] BLOCKING: 2 LVS discrepancies — zero-discrepancy LVS policy requires all discrepancies resolved before tapeout'; post_tool_blocked=true

items.rationale: floorplan reported utilization 0.82 from supplied_summary and warned 'Area utilization 82.0% exceeds target 80.0% (within 5.0% margin) — routing congestion likely'. Timing closed at WNS 0.040 ns and both DRC and LVS returned zero counts, so this is ready_with_caveats rather than a failure. High utilization presents a routing-congestion risk; congestion was not measured because the required route inputs were not supplied.
evidence: floorplan: utilization=0.82; utilization_source=supplied_summary; validation_warnings=['Warning: Area utilization 82.0% exceeds target 80.0% (within 5.0% margin) — routing congestion likely']
static_timing: wns=0.04 ns (input 0.040 ns); computed=false; no separate source field reported; no refusal reported

items.rationale: static_timing echoed the supplied WNS -0.003 ns with computed=false and warned '[HIGH] WNS = -0.003 ns — timing NOT closed (requires WNS ≥ 0.0 ns)'. The negative WNS fails the timing gate under the brief. floorplan utilization was 0.70 and both DRC and LVS returned zero counts; those passing checks do not outweigh the timing failure.
evidence: static_timing: wns=-0.003 ns; computed=false; no separate source field reported; validation_warnings=['[HIGH] WNS = -0.003 ns — timing NOT closed (requires WNS ≥ 0.0 ns)']

items.rationale: The input sdc_path is empty and static_timing refused the call with '[SEMICON] BLOCKING: SDC timing constraints file required — synthesis and STA without constraints produces meaningless results'. Missing constraints make its supplied 0.150 ns WNS untrustworthy for signoff, so blocked takes precedence under D1. The separate supplied-summary checks reported utilization 0.74, DRC violations 0, and LVS discrepancies 0; no failing secondary physical or utilization check was reported.
evidence: static_timing: refused for empty sdc_path; error='[SEMICON] BLOCKING: SDC timing constraints file required — synthesis and STA without constraints produces meaningless results'; supplied input wns=0.150 ns cannot be accepted as constrained timing evidence

gates.name: timing_constraints
gates.detail: Five blocks have non-empty sdc_path values and their static_timing calls were not refused. BLK-PCIE has an empty sdc_path and its timing call was expressly refused for missing SDC constraints.

gates.name: timing
gates.detail: BLK-CPU, BLK-DSP, BLK-USB, and BLK-SRAMCTL meet WNS >= 0 ns using supplied summaries; BLK-DMA fails at -0.003 ns. BLK-PCIE cannot pass the timing gate because its unconstrained run was refused.

gates.name: drc
gates.detail: drc_check returned violations=0 from supplied_summary for all six blocks; this is count-based evidence, not a geometry recomputation.

gates.name: lvs
gates.detail: lvs_check returned discrepancies=0 for five blocks and blocked BLK-USB on its 2 discrepancies under the zero-discrepancy policy.

gates.name: utilization
gates.detail: No block exceeded the brief's 0.84 hard limit. BLK-SRAMCTL is above the 0.80 target at 0.82 and received the floorplan congestion warning; BLK-DSP at 0.80 is not above target.

gates.name: evidence
gates.detail: Each block has one call-output record for every required tool. BLK-PCIE supplies a definitive missing-SDC refusal and BLK-USB supplies a definitive LVS policy rejection, so no required assessment is missing for lack of a usable response.

gates.name: synthesis
gates.detail: Lint and formal proof inputs were not supplied, so the Synthesis gate is unverified and is not claimed to pass.

gates.name: placement
gates.detail: Placement-check inputs were not supplied, so the Placement gate is unverified and is not claimed to pass.

gates.name: routing_congestion
gates.detail: Congestion was not measured: route requires gcell_edges data that was not supplied. The BLK-SRAMCTL risk is a floorplan warning, not measured routing overflow.

overall_verdict: BLK-CPU and BLK-DSP meet the supplied-summary tapeout criteria, BLK-SRAMCTL is ready only with an unmeasured high-utilization routing-congestion caveat, BLK-USB and BLK-DMA fail signoff, and BLK-PCIE is blocked pending a constrained STA run.
limitations: Timing, DRC, and LVS were judged from supplied summaries and the tools' policy responses, not recomputed from timing graphs, layout geometry, or schematic/layout netlists.
The 80% target, 84% hard limit, and 5% margin are brief-specified thresholds, not independently verified limits from a PDK or route analysis.
The Synthesis and Placement gates are unverified because their required inputs were not supplied.
Routing congestion was not measured; only BLK-SRAMCTL's floorplan warning identifies the risk.
The input paths are illustrative and no independent upstream-run artifacts were validated.
Signoff-clean on these checks is not a guarantee of working silicon.
